name: Ledger
description: Ledger is a website template for accounting offices that keep the books for sole traders and companies, with an audience switch for four kinds of clients, a fee calculator that counts documents, employees and contracts and highlights the matching plan in the price table, a tax calendar that follows the form of business and counts the days to the next deadline, and a four step switch from another office. Burgundy accents on bone paper with Newsreader headings give the website a calm, trustworthy character. Replace the copy, photos, office details, prices, tax dates and reviews with your own before publishing.
features: Audience switch for sole traders, companies, e-commerce and medical practices
Fee calculator that highlights the matching plan in the price table
Price table with four plans and extras
Tax calendar that follows the form of business, with a countdown to the next deadline
Four step switch from another office
Service pages for sole traders, companies, payroll and tax advice
Team section for the people who sign the returns
Client reviews, to be replaced with genuine testimonials
FAQ with a sticky intro and FAQPage structured data
